lines.en: I walk with a bounce.
I trot along, crunching the leaf litter.

lines.zh: 我从灌木里钻出来，很快就跑开。
lines.en: I pop out of the brush and run off.
I run through the flower forest.
My feet are strong.

lines.zh: 我走两步就回头看一下。
lines.en: Two steps, one glance back.
I follow the smell of cooking smoke.

lines.zh: 我在锚点附近转来转去。
lines.en: I wander around the anchor.

lines.zh: 我的步子很小，但频率高。
lines.en: Small steps, but quick.
Leaf litter rustles under me.

lines.zh: 我从一棵树跳到另一棵树下面。
lines.en: I hop from under one tree to the next.

lines.zh: 我跑起来，尾巴在后面甩。
lines.en: When I run, my tail swings behind.

lines.zh: 我尾巴一下一下扫着草。
lines.en: My tail sweeps the grass, back and forth.
Say the word and I'll run the errand.

lines.zh: 我还是成长期的小个子。
lines.en: I am still the small growth-stage one.
I tilt my head at the light in the trees.
I grin and show a row of small teeth.
I shake the leaves off.

lines.zh: 我记得自己叫 V 仔兽。
lines.en: I remember being called V-mon.
I am still growing.
My claws can strip bark.
You stay quiet, so do I.
I can run a long way.
A small hum through my nose.
I sit and look up.
Four kinds of birds are calling in the wood.
Are you here to take me along?
I look up. You are much taller.
Say fight and I'm in.
I can run, and I can fight.
I will follow and not get lost.
Slow down. I startle easily.
I know the smell you carry.
If you go, I come.
I sit and wait for you.
There is soil on your boots.
I am not much afraid of strangers.
But I do not like being carried.
Call me and I come.
I will wait here.
Shall we go together?
My belly is gurgling.
I yelp and spring aside.
That actually hurt.
Tail tucked, I back off behind a tree.
My legs shake, but I stand.
My mouth hangs open and I'm panting hard.
A little wound like this is nothing.
I rub the sore spot.
I can still run.
I'll be taking this back from you.
I can hold out.
There really is meat over there!
Share a piece with me.
One sniff and I have it.
On the ground, not in your hand.
I will finish it in one bite.
What else is in that pack?
The meat's gone and I'm still licking.
There's still meat smell between your fingers.
I lick my lips.
This piece is really good.
I will leave one for you.
My belly's full; I burp.

lines.zh: 我被顶得往后滑了半尺。
lines.en: I skid half a foot backwards.
I am much lighter than you.
It is fine. It does not hurt.
You stepped on my foot.
I turn sideways and slip through the gap.

lines.zh: 我被顶得在落叶上打滑。
lines.en: I skid across the leaf litter.
I am not down. I still stand.
Do not push into me.
Let us just walk together.
My grip is good.
I have not even lost my first teeth.
That waits until I grow up.
First I have to get stronger.
My kin are in these woods.
That is an odd question.
I do not follow that.
I will evolve into something else.
Ask me when I am grown.
I am going for a run.
Do not trail after me.
I pick up a round stone.
This can be thrown far.
I stuff it into a hole under the roots.
This branch is good.
I swing it twice.
Two bites and it won't give.
Too hard; my teeth won't dent it.
I toss it away.
Is this thing yours?
I lift it and offer it to you.
A shadow behind the tree.
I duck low and tuck my tail.
I've counted the strides; I can leap any moment.
My throat feels hot.
Get behind my back.
I have my aim.
It is a whole size bigger.
But I am not afraid.
Heat gathers at the back of my throat.
First one, then two.
This is already the third!
Here I go!
I'll know the moment its forefoot lifts.
It moves, and I switch sides.
My legs keep moving.
The moment it shows a gap, I move.
It shrank back.
I follow at once.
I will not let it get away.
It is taller, not faster.

lines.zh: 我从它的后腿边溜过去。
lines.en: I slip past its hind leg.
Its eyes have found me.
It turned half a beat too slow.
I have leapt in!
My claws rake across its hide.
I butt once, then hop clear.
That lacked force.
I clamp down on its ankle.

lines.zh: 它把我甩出去，我打了滚。
lines.en: It flings me off and I roll away.
I get up and go again.
My foot lands on it.
That made it back off.
It backs off; I press in.
I chase it down and bite again.
Panting, I swing my claws and don't stop.
I want to keep going.

lines.zh: 我落地的时候翻了个身。
lines.en: I land and roll over once.
The first thing I see is green.
I stand on two legs, a little unsteady.
Two running steps, no fall.
I run very fast.
Many trees here. Many flowers.
I remember which way my anchor lies.
I run that way.
There is movement in the woods.
I prick my ears up.
First I will look around.
Then I will decide.
A spark bit my hide.
I fall and roll twice.
Water closes over me; I kick hard.

lines.zh: 气浪把我吹起来又摔下。
lines.en: The blast lifts me and slams me down.
An arrow is in my shin.
I go numb and cannot move.
Too hungry to run.
The thunder locks me up.
I claw at the air, falling.
